details.undoNoShowBody: This reopens the match so it can be played or reported normally. Standings are unaffected — a no-show never counted.
details.deleteResultBody: This clears the score and winner and reopens the match. You can report the result again afterwards.
details.replaceNoShowBody: This replaces the no-show with a real result and counts it towards the standings.
details.changeWinnerBody: This changes the winner and re-advances the bracket.
details.linkedReopenTitle_one: {{count}} linked result will also be reopened
details.linkedReopenTitle_other: {{count}} linked results will also be reopened
details.dwGameBody: Neither {{home}} nor {{away}} played this game, so it closes as a no-show and counts for neither team. The tie is decided by the games that were played — if none end up played, the whole tie is voided (both teams out, or zero points in a league). You can still enter a real result later. Continue?
details.dwEliminationBody: Neither {{home}} nor {{away}} played, so both are eliminated and their opponent advances by walkover. This usually can't be undone once the opponent moves on. Continue?
details.dwDefaultBody: Neither {{home}} nor {{away}} played, so the match closes as a no-show: no points for either player (not a draw) and the round can continue. You can still enter a real result later. Continue?
details.nobodyPlayed: Nobody played — no points for either side
details.opponentMustConfirm: Your opponent needs to confirm before this match is final.
details.proposerReported: {{name}} reported the result. Confirm if it's correct.
details.overwriteProposal: This will overwrite the proposal and finalize the match.
details.updateAndNotify: Update the score and tap Update Report to notify your opponent.
details.tiebreakNeededBody: The series finished level. Add the tiebreak games to decide the match.
details.dwHintGame: Both players failed to play — closes this game as a no-show. It counts for neither team; if no game of the tie is played, the whole tie is voided.
details.dwHintElimination: Both players failed to play — closes this match with no winner and advances their opponent automatically.
details.dwHintDefault: Both players failed to play — closes this match as a no-show. No points for either player (not a draw).

details.updatesResultBody: This updates the result. The winner stays the same, so the rest of the bracket is unaffected.

formatPicker.appliesToEveryGame: Applies to every individual game inside a tie — the tie itself is still decided by its own win condition.
formatPicker.aggregateHint: Every game is played and the scores are added up — the higher total wins. Useful for two-legged ties.
formatPicker.matchWinsHint: Whoever wins more games wins the series, and it ends as soon as the lead is out of reach.
formatPicker.knockoutSameHint: Knockout matches are played over the same length as the {{phase}}.
formatPicker.perRoundOverride: Each round can still be changed on its own once the bracket exists.
formatPicker.tiebreakNote: Individual games may be drawn, so a series can end level at any format. Knockout matches always go to a tiebreak; league, group and Swiss matches record it as a draw.

verification.title: Result verification
verification.intro: Start screen recording on the game result, switch to GameHubz for the biometric check, then stop and attach the recording.
verification.stepRecord: Start screen recording on the result
verification.stepAttach: Stop recording and attach the video
verification.a11yHint: Confirms it's you with your phone's biometrics, then attaches your recording of the final score.
verification.accountCameFirst: The account {{name}} used this phone before {{player}} did.
verification.failedAttempt: {{name}} · {{time}} · {{device}} — the proof didn't match the phone's key
verification.lockout: Too many attempts. Unlock your phone with its passcode, then try again.
verification.selectRecordingHint: Stop screen recording and attach the video (up to {{seconds}} s).
verification.uploadFailedBody: Upload failed. Check your connection and retry — your biometric check still counts for 30 minutes.
verification.photosPermission: Allow access to your photos to attach the recording.
verification.videoTooLong: That recording is longer than {{seconds}} s. Trim it to the final score and pick it again.
verification.videoUnsupported: This app version can't upload video. Update GameHubz.
verification.videoFailed: The video couldn't be prepared. Try another recording.
verification.verifiedBody: Your verification is on record: this match, your account, this phone and the time. You can report the result now.
verification.unavailableIos: Set up Face ID or Touch ID, and make sure it's allowed for GameHubz in Settings, to verify results.
verification.unavailableAndroid: Set up a fingerprint (or a face unlock your phone counts as strong biometrics) in Settings to verify results.
verification.privacy: Your face and fingerprint never leave your phone. GameHubz only learns that your phone's own {{biometric}} check passed — tied to this phone, this match and the time.
verification.promptRegister: Confirm this phone for tournament verification
verification.phoneApprovalPending: Waiting for organizer approval for this phone
